comparison_policy.notes: Build the tree from the learner profile first. If focus + best/known languages do not provide enough context, add reference languages until the tree is useful. Never add filler after the learner already has enough languages to show the relationships.

experience_blueprint.notes: This is the default first orientation topic after a language is added. The same scene data must render in app, print, and video pipelines.

notes: Genealogy is a historical relationship model, not a claim that related languages are mutually intelligible or culturally interchangeable. Language realizations own reviewed genealogy facts; the runtime chooses which branches to display from the learner context.
